name: io.github.yyxqqq777/agentpay
title: AgentPay
description: x402 micropayments MCP: Xiaohongshu notes and paid APIs settled in USDC on Base.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EVM private key for signing USDC micropayments on Base (wallet must hold USDC)

environmentVariables.name: MAX_SPEND_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Maximum USDC the agent may spend per API call (default: 0.10)

environmentVariables.name: GATEWAY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional override of the AgentPay gateway URL
